title: mpv-winui menu bar definition
description: Structure of the config-driven menu bar (Menus/menus.json). Each entry is a separator, a submenu (children), or a leaf running either an app action or a raw mpv command. See Modules/Player/Menu/MenuDefinition.cs.

id.description: Unique item id (used for logging and menu identity).

labelKey.description: AppLang property name holding the localized label.

labelArgs.description: Optional format arguments for the label (e.g. "{0} min").

icon.description: Optional FontIcon glyph (Fluent System Icons codepoint).

mpvCommand.description: Raw mpv command executed on click.

separator.description: True renders a separator; other fields ignored.
